question: The _____ developed 32-bit microprocessors for space applications named VIKRAM3201 and KALPANA3201.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO)** developed the 32-bit microprocessors named **VIKRAM3201** and **KALPANA3201** specifically for space applications.
 
• The microprocessors were designed to enhance computational capabilities for spacecraft systems, ensuring better reliability and performance during missions.
